statements.statement: I graduated from Birmingham Newman University on 2 July 2026 with a First-Class BSc (Hons) in Computer Science.
My final-year dissertation project, SCAFAD, investigated anomaly detection within AWS Lambda environments using serverless telemetry.
In May 2022, I worked as an assistant at the British Chamber of Commerce Moldova without a written employment contract; I can seek confirmation from the employer.
In 2022, I worked as a translator and interpreter for the Counter Trafficking Network in Moldova.
In 2023, I worked as a DHL operative in Telford.
I have paid experience providing online English lessons.
I held a customer-facing direct-sales role in Birmingham and recruited, trained or coached new starters; it was not a B2B sales role.
Northern Ray was a genuine unpaid external-client website/application project that the client later abandoned; I personally designed or implemented material parts of it.
I completed a frontend-only website project before my current flagship projects.
I earned nine GCSEs, seven at grade 7 or higher, and a LIBF Financial Studies qualification with Distinction.

I directed AI agents to implement Market Aligner, including its collectors, validation, caching, SQLite persistence, retries and resumability; I did not personally hand-write the material production code.
For my multi-agent orchestrator, I own requirements, system architecture, operation, evaluation and acceptance decisions; AI agents generated substantial implementation code.
My GitHub account is `Pepstee`; its strongest career evidence supports three main bodies of work: the multi-agent software factory, SCAFAD and software produced through the factory.

Dubbing Studio is a working MVP produced autonomously through my software factory; I provided product direction, operated the factory and validated the result rather than personally implementing every component.
In the audited Dubbing Studio checkout, 709 automated tests passed and a real command-line synthesis check produced a timeline-correct WAV; its web acceptance script still required repair.

Learning Accelerator is a tested software-factory prototype for LLM-assisted question generation, spaced repetition, review sessions, persistence and analytics; it has not yet demonstrated real users or learning outcomes.
The public `scafad-delta` repository is supporting implementation evidence for my SCAFAD dissertation, not a separate professional project or proof of production security experience.
The public `claude-orchestrator-deprecated` repository is historical evidence for my software-factory architecture, but it is deprecated and should not be presented as the current production release.
